verdict.rationale: AMD documents AV1 encode/decode support for the RX 9070 XT, satisfying part of the media-engine claim, but there is no mention of HEVC encode/decode capability or any professional/ISV-certified driver support (e.g., Adobe, DaVinci Resolve, or Pro certification programs) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: HEVC encoder/decoder documentation, ISV/professional certification claims, creator-app specific acceleration details.
